title: My Normal Day
gist_ar: واحد بيوصف روتينه اليومي من الصبح لبالليل.

before_listening.en: Someone describes an ordinary day. Listen for what he does in the EVENING.
before_listening.ar: حد بيوصف يوم عادي. ركّز على بيعمل إيه بالليل.

segments.speaker: Sami
segments.text: I get up at six o'clock every day. I drink tea and I eat bread with cheese. I go to work at seven. I work in an office with my friends. We start at eight. We have lunch at one. I finish work at four. I come home and I sleep for one hour. In the evening I study English. I go to bed at eleven. On Friday I do not work. I visit my family.

questions.q: What time does he get up?
What does he do in the evening?
